title: Manual field locks
description: Locked canonical fields still collect candidates and conflicts but cannot enter execution. Releasing a lock never applies accumulated values.

fields.conflict: Conflict ID resolved to keep canonical

messages.required: Enter a conflict ID and a reason of at least 3 characters
messages.lockFailed: Lock failed. The conflict must be resolved by keeping canonical.
messages.reasonRequired: A release reason of at least 3 characters is required
messages.released: Field lock released. No candidate was applied.
messages.releaseFailed: Release failed. Check status or version.
